title: 25.10.0-RC2
summary: 25.10.0-RC2 Important This RC is a recommended update for Holesky and Sepolia users for the Fusaka hardfork. This RC is still pending burn in for mainnet. This RC includes an update for a dependency used in PeerDAS. There is likely to be another release before Hoodi's Fusaka fork.
